paragraphs.body: What we sell, who buys it, and what it costs
paragraphs.heading: One agency offer for local shops
paragraphs.say: ListeningKit is a marketing agency for local shops. We sell one thing: a steady flow of booked jobs. Websites that load fast and rank. Search optimisation, paid ads, and answer engine optimisation so AI assistants recommend you. Missed call capture, intent listening, and a CRM with follow up so no lead goes cold.

paragraphs.body: Websites, SEO, ads, AEO, calls, listening, CRM
paragraphs.heading: Seven services, one booked job
paragraphs.say: Websites first, because everything points at the site. Then SEO so Google finds you, and PPC ads for immediate calls. AEO so ChatGPT and voice assistants quote your shop by name. Missed call capture texts back every missed caller in seconds. Intent listening watches reviews, competitors and demand signals. And the CRM plus follow up turns every click and call into a booked appointment.

paragraphs.heading: Shops with bays, vans and phones
paragraphs.say: We sell to tint shops, detailing studios, autobody and collision shops, and local trades with vans on the road. One owner, a small crew, a phone that has to ring. If the business lives or dies on booked jobs, it fits.

paragraphs.body: One price card, the same for every shop
paragraphs.heading: A uniform price card
paragraphs.say: And we sell it on a uniform price card, the same for every shop. One thousand dollars setup for the first phone line. Five hundred for each added line, capped at five thousand. Three hundred dollars per line per month. Bundles at five fifty and eight hundred a month. Tooling at cost, passed through, never marked up.

paragraphs.heading: The ladder: Site, Stack, Grow
paragraphs.say: Then pick a rung on the ladder. Site at three fifty a month: the website that ranks and converts. Stack at six forty nine: site plus SEO, ads management and follow up. Grow at nine ninety nine: the full stack with AEO, intent listening and priority support. Start on Site, climb to Grow when the phones prove it.
